# Setlist to Playlist

> A free web app that turns concert setlists from Setlist.fm into Spotify playlists in the order the songs were played.

## What it does

- Search concert setlists by artist, city, and year.
- Review the songs, including covers and encores, before creating a playlist.
- Sign in to Spotify with Authorization Code with PKCE and create a playlist in the visitor's own Spotify account.
- New playlists are private by default; the visitor can choose to make one public.

## Important facts

- Website: https://setlist-to-playlist.krynsky.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/krynsky/Setlist-to-Playlist
- Creator: Mark Krynsky (https://krynsky.com/)
- Data source: Setlist.fm
- Playlist service: Spotify
- Cost: Free and open source; visitors provide their own Setlist.fm API key and Spotify Client ID when running a local or Pinokio installation.

## Privacy

- The hosted demo uses Spotify's browser-based PKCE sign-in flow; Spotify credentials are not stored by this app.
- Spotify access and refresh tokens remain in the visitor's browser for their session.
- Locally installed and Pinokio versions use credentials supplied by the person running the app.
